claims.quote: Topical NSAIDs, such as diclofenac, are recommended as a first-line treatment.

claims.text: Topical forms (patch or gel) preferred over PO ← ⍉GI AEs
claims.quote: These agents are recommended as first-line pharmacological treatments; however, topical (eg, ibuprofen or diclofenac in patch or gel) forms are preferred to avoid adverse gastrointestinal effects.
